house.definition: A building designed for people to live in.

apartment.definition: A suite of rooms usually on one floor of an apartment house.

condo.definition: An individually owned home in a building or development with shared areas.

townhouse.definition: A home designed for one family, attached to neighboring homes in a row by shared side walls and usually built on several floors.

studio.definition: A dwelling with its main living and sleeping space combined in one room, with separate bathroom facilities.

penthouse.definition: An apartment located on the top floors of a building.

loft.definition: A home with a large open living space, often converted from an industrial building.

cottage.definition: A small house, often in the countryside.

duplex.definition: In this US housing example, a building containing two separate homes; elsewhere the term can mean one home across two floors.

office-building.definition: A building designed mainly for workplaces where people perform business, professional, or administrative tasks.

retail-store.definition: A shop that sells goods directly to individual customers for their own use.

warehouse.definition: A large building used for storing goods.

factory.definition: A plant consisting of one or more buildings with facilities for manufacturing.

restaurant-space.definition: A commercial property area designed or suitable for use as a restaurant.
restaurant-space.exampleUsage: The listing describes the restaurant space as having a kitchen area.

shopping-center.definition: A purpose-built site that combines shops, services, and common facilities under unified planning and management.

mixed-use.definition: Designed to combine residential, commercial, and other functions within one building, site, or area.

showroom.definition: An area where merchandise (such as cars) can be displayed.

coworking-space.definition: A shared workplace where people from different companies or independent jobs can use desks and common facilities.
coworking-space.exampleUsage: The building includes a coworking space on the second floor.

farmhouse.definition: A house on a farm or built in a traditional rural style.

ranch.definition: In this property-style context, a low ranch-style house mainly on one level, rather than a livestock farm.

cabin.definition: A small, simple house, often made of wood.

beach-house.definition: A house located directly on a beach or within easy reach of the coast.

houseboat.definition: A barge that is designed and equipped for use as a dwelling.

tiny-house.definition: A very small home designed to provide basic living spaces within a limited floor area.
tiny-house.exampleUsage: The tiny house uses compact storage to save space.

mobile-home.definition: A dwelling designed as a transportable unit that may be installed at a residential site.

castle.definition: A large fortified building, historically used by rulers or nobles.

bungalow.definition: A house usually built on one main story, sometimes with a smaller upper level in the roof.

square-footage.definition: The area of a floor or property measured in square feet.
square-footage.exampleUsage: The listing states the apartment's square footage.

lot-size.definition: The total area of a piece of land on which a property stands.
lot-size.exampleUsage: The property listing includes the lot size.

bedrooms.definition: A room used primarily for sleeping.

bathrooms.definition: A room or building equipped with one or more toilets.

garage.definition: A building or room used to keep a vehicle.

pool.definition: A structure filled with water for swimming.

view.definition: The scenery visible from a property.

parking.definition: Space in which vehicles can be parked.

storage.definition: Space for keeping belongings until they are needed.

hotel.definition: A building or business providing temporary accommodation for paying guests.

garden.definition: An outdoor area where plants are grown or displayed.
